purpose: Teach: 連合/入手/出場/総務/プレス/出荷/故障/名義

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、連合、絶対、を、絶対、組む、絶対、戦略、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to seriously explore forming a strategic alliance with the industry. This is important.
lines.style: Direct, clipped authority. Crisp attack on each instruction. No softening. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone whose words don't need repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新しい原材料の、本気で、絶対、入手、絶対、ルート、絶対、確保しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've secured a new sourcing route for raw materials. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgment. Slight nod on 「はい」. Even pacing. Respectful but not deferential — reporting facts cleanly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の見本市、本気で、絶対、出場、絶対、当社、絶対、決定しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want a decision made: we're exhibiting at the industry trade show. Make it happen.
lines.style: Firm, no hedging. Short sentences. Lean forward slightly on the instruction. Weight on the decision itself, not the process.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。総務、絶対、部、絶対、と、絶対、業務、絶対、連携、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're coordinating with the general affairs department on logistics. The work is moving forward.
lines.style: Methodical reporting. Even breath. Slight emphasis on progress words. Professional tone without nervousness — this is routine for him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、プレス、絶対、リリース、絶対、慎重に、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Handle the press release carefully. Don't rush it. I'm relying on you to get this right.
lines.style: Measured, slightly slower. Weight on the caution. Not urgent, but serious. The pause before 「進めろ」 gives emphasis to care over speed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の、本気で、絶対、出荷、絶対、予定通り、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The new product shipment is proceeding on schedule as planned.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Steady rhythm. No unnecessary words. The confidence of someone reporting that nothing has derailed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 設備の、本気で、絶対、故障、絶対、絶対、なきよう、絶対、点検しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Inspect the equipment thoroughly. I don't want any failures. Ensure everything is checked.
lines.style: Sharp, almost clipped. Emphasis on the prevention aspect. Controlled intensity — not angry, but demanding precision and care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。契約書の、本気で、絶対、名義、絶対、確認、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're verifying all contract names and details. Everything is being reviewed carefully.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly formal. Slower pace on verification details. Closing tone — this is the last update, delivered with thoroughness.
